purpose: Requirements for the agenda display layer, which generates a human-readable presentation from the agenda record so users get an overview, see changes, and never see presentation diverge from the record.
summary: Overview: display is separated from storage so the presentation is generated from the record, avoiding boundary conflicts
Terminology follows the record layer requirements, with no new terms
Scope: presentation generated from records, overview, change visibility, and consistency; storage, timing, etiquette, and content correctness are out of scope
FNC-001: one agenda shows all items, states, and remaining count, keeping withdrawn and out-of-scope items visible
FNC-002: changes from the latest update are distinguishable in the presentation
FNC-003: presentation is generated from the record and the AI has no path to write it directly
FNC-004: the AI does not need to read the human-facing presentation to learn state
FNC-005: a user-specified item number can be reached directly
NFR-001: the presentation shows that it is a generated artifact
TBD-001 resolved: HTML is adopted, with implementation pattern defined in the design document
tasks: Designing or implementing the agenda display generation
Implementing change highlighting in the presentation
Adding direct navigation to items by number
Reviewing agenda display requirements and designs
Integrating a caller such as consult with the agenda display
title: REQ-021 agenda 表示層 要件定義書
